title: MASTER’S THESIS DEFENSE

text: MASTER’S THESIS DEFENSE
Governing Long-Term Memory Before Retrieval
KEEP · SUPERSEDE · ABSTAIN over typed, provenance-tracked, lineage-preserving memory
textPreview: KEEP · SUPERSEDE · ABSTAIN over typed, provenance-tracked, lineage-preserving memory

text: Ali Mohammadi · ASK Memory Governance · 2026

Open with the research question: can a memory system decide whether a new claim should be committed, replace an older claim, or be refused? Preview that the thesis evaluates this decision directly, not only downstream answer accuracy.

title: MOTIVATION

text: MOTIVATION
Long-term memory is a mutable state, not a document collection
textPreview: Long-term memory is a mutable state, not a document collection

text: Every write changes what the agent will later treat as true.
textPreview: Every write changes what the agent will later treat as true.

text: A retrieval score cannot decide whether evidence is compatible, superseding, or too ambiguous to commit.
textPreview: A retrieval score cannot decide whether evidence is compatible, superseding, or too ambiguous to commit.

text: Frame memory as an epistemic state. The key risk appears before retrieval: a bad write can remain active and influence many future answers.

title: Retrieval-only pipelines leave the write decision implicit

text: Retrieval-only pipelines leave the write decision implicit
textPreview: Retrieval-only pipelines leave the write decision implicit

text: Retrieval-centric memory
store → rank → answer
Optimizes whether a relevant item is found. Conflict handling, uncertainty, and history are side effects.
textPreview: Optimizes whether a relevant item is found. Conflict handling, uncertainty, and history are side effects.

text: Governed memory
inspect → decide → transition
Makes the write action explicit, preserves superseded history, and audits why state changed.
textPreview: Makes the write action explicit, preserves superseded history, and audits why state changed.

text: Contrast the two abstractions. This thesis does not argue retrieval is unnecessary; it argues retrieval begins after a governance decision has already shaped the state.

text: The research gap is a missing, measurable write boundary
textPreview: The research gap is a missing, measurable write boundary

text: Action
Most systems expose ADD/UPDATE/NOOP but do not score whether the operation was correct under conflict.
textPreview: Most systems expose ADD/UPDATE/NOOP but do not score whether the operation was correct under conflict.

text: Uncertainty
NOOP often means ‘nothing new,’ not ‘evidence is unsafe to commit.’
textPreview: NOOP often means ‘nothing new,’ not ‘evidence is unsafe to commit.’

text: History
Overwrite can hide the losing claim; append-only memory can leave contradictions simultaneously active.
textPreview: Overwrite can hide the losing claim; append-only memory can leave contradictions simultaneously active.

text: Evaluation
Answer accuracy cannot localize whether failure came from a write, state transition, retrieval, or generation.
textPreview: Answer accuracy cannot localize whether failure came from a write, state transition, retrieval, or generation.

text: State the narrow gap. Avoid primacy claims: related systems contain update actions, versioning, and abstention-like ideas. The contribution is the operationalized combination and layered evaluation.

title: The policy fixes three write actions and their state semantics

text: The policy fixes three write actions and their state semantics
textPreview: The policy fixes three write actions and their state semantics

text: The action vocabulary is fixed by code; the model may propose, but cannot invent a fourth transition.
textPreview: The action vocabulary is fixed by code; the model may propose, but cannot invent a fourth transition.

text: KEEP
Insert a compatible claim as active. Existing non-conflicting records remain active.
textPreview: Insert a compatible claim as active. Existing non-conflicting records remain active.

text: SUPERSEDE
Insert the new claim, deactivate the conflicting prior, and record a lineage link.
textPreview: Insert the new claim, deactivate the conflicting prior, and record a lineage link.

text: ABSTAIN
Do not mutate memory. Record the conflict or ambiguity for review.
textPreview: Do not mutate memory. Record the conflict or ambiguity for review.

text: Source: thesis §3–4; src/ask/memory/operations.py
Define each action precisely. Stress that ABSTAIN is a no-mutation safety action, not an answer-level refusal, and that SUPERSEDE preserves the old record for audit.
